samples.question: What computer vision projects has Dinupa built?

sources.title: Road Sign Detection with YOLO and ONNX
sources.text:
Title: Road Sign Detection with YOLO and ONNX
Type: Computer vision prototype
Summary: Two-stage road-sign recognition pipeline. YOLO localizes candidate signs and an ONNX classifier separates speed limits, traffic lights, no-honking signs, and other signs for Raspberry Pi style deployment.
Areas: Computer vision, Edge deployment
Stack: YOLO, ONNX Runtime, NCNN, OpenCV, Python, Raspberry Pi
Metrics: 9,062 image test set, NCNN/Raspberry Pi deployment work
Link: https://github.com/Dinuxd/road-sign-detection-yolo-onnx

sources.title: Smart Fish Habitat Management System
sources.text:
Title: Smart Fish Habitat Management System
Type: Raspberry Pi automation and vision project
Summary: Automated aquarium system for water-quality monitoring, scheduled feeding, water changing, filtration, aeration, and heating. The project also tested YOLOv11 fish detection and TensorFlow Lite vision work for water-quality assessment.
Areas: Embedded systems, Computer vision, Automation
Stack: Raspberry Pi 4, Python, DS18B20, PH-4502C, TensorFlow Lite, YOLOv11
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/dinupadevinda_im-happy-to-share-this-advanced-automated-ugcPost-7344258111374794753-unXK/

sources.title: Vehicular Black Box: Vehicle Violation Detector
sources.text:
Title: Vehicular Black Box: Vehicle Violation Detector
Type: Final-year integrated ML and embedded system
Summary: Raspberry Pi based vehicle black-box prototype combining camera, audio, IMU, GPS/GSM inputs, violation and driving-event modules, evidence upload, backend services, and a React dashboard.
Areas: Computer vision, Audio ML, Sensor fusion, Embedded systems, Backend, Full stack
Stack: Raspberry Pi 4B, Python, TFLite, ONNX, NCNN, Go, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript
Link: https://github.com/Dinuxd/vehicular-black-box-violation-detector
Limitations: Prototype with validation notes and limitations documented. Do not describe it as a production-ready safety system.

samples.question: What audio machine learning projects has Dinupa built?

sources.title: Crash Detection with Audio and IMU Sensor Fusion
sources.text:
Title: Crash Detection with Audio and IMU Sensor Fusion
Type: FYP module
Summary: Crash detection module combining audio and IMU signals. It packages separate model outputs into fusion labels for the vehicular black-box prototype.
Areas: Audio ML, IMU data, Sensor fusion
Stack: PyTorch, TensorFlow/Keras, CNN-GRU, log-mel, Raspberry Pi, Python
Link: https://github.com/Dinuxd/crash-detection-audio-imu-fusion

sources.title: Vehicle Horn Detection with Audio CNN
sources.text:
Title: Vehicle Horn Detection with Audio CNN
Type: Audio ML prototype
Summary: Vehicle horn detector using 1-second microphone windows, log-mel features, CNN training, and TensorFlow Lite export for lightweight inference.
Areas: Audio ML, Signal processing, Edge deployment
Stack: TensorFlow, Keras, TFLite, librosa, SpecAugment, Python
Link: https://github.com/Dinuxd/vehicle-horn-detection-audio-cnn
Limitations: Internal metrics are strong; field validation is the next step.

samples.question: What backend projects has Dinupa built?

sources.title: AI Portfolio Assistant with RAG and Vector Search
sources.text:
Title: AI Portfolio Assistant with RAG and Vector Search
Type: Portfolio chatbot and retrieval system
Summary: Portfolio chatbot built with a Cloudflare Worker, Gemini, Cloudflare Vectorize, keyword retrieval, reciprocal-rank fusion, and clickable portfolio sources. The project also includes a Dockerized local Python and Chroma RAG setup for learning, retrieval testing, and offline experiments.
Areas: LLM integration, RAG, Embeddings, Vector search, Evaluation, Serverless backend, AI systems
Stack: Gemini API, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Vectorize, Python, Chroma, sentence-transformers, Docker, Next.js, TypeScript, Evaluation harness
Metrics: Hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, Structured source validation, 20-question retrieval evaluation set
Link: https://github.com/Dinuxd/dinupadevinda.com
Limitations: Personal portfolio chatbot used to practice retrieval, evaluation, and serverless AI integration.

sources.text:
Title: BRMS Boarding Room Management API
Type: Backend project
Summary: Java Spring Boot REST API for boarding-room management workflows with Spring Data JPA, SQL Server configuration, environment-based settings, and H2-backed testing.
Areas: Backend, REST APIs
Stack: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, SQL Server, H2
Link: https://github.com/Dinuxd/brms-spring-boot-api
